1_what_files_accessed.question: WHAT files/information were accessed?
1_what_files_accessed.summary: Four confidential project files were compromised and bundled into a 142.8 MB archive:

items.description: Proprietary Autonomous Drone Navigation core algorithm source code
Trained transformer model weights representing 500+ flight simulation hours
Raw LiDAR point cloud benchmark dataset
Unpublished final dissertation draft and patent disclosures

2_when_did_activity_occur.question: WHEN did the suspicious activity occur?
2_when_did_activity_occur.summary: October 4, 2026 between 18:14:20 UTC and 18:42:10 UTC (Duration: ~28 minutes).

key_milestones.event: Unauthorized RDP session initiated by dvance
142.8 MB cloud upload completed to dropfile.to

3_how_accessed.question: HOW were the files accessed?
3_how_accessed.summary: Lateral Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) session combined with local file system navigation.
3_how_accessed.mechanism: The suspect established an RDP connection (Logon Type 10) from his personal laptop DEV-LAPTOP-14 (192.168.1.78) to victim machine LAB-WS-07 (192.168.1.45) on TCP port 3389 immediately after the victim locked the screen. Using GUI explorer and 7z.exe, the files in C:\Projects\FinalYear_DroneAI\ were traversed and staged into C:\Users\Public\project_backup_v2.zip.

4_how_exfiltrated.question: HOW were they potentially exfiltrated/shared?
4_how_exfiltrated.summary: Dual-channel exfiltration: Anonymous Cloud File Upload + Direct Competitor Email Sharing (with backup USB copy).
details: Primary Exfiltration: High-volume HTTPS POST upload (143.1 MB) via Google Chrome to ephemeral file hosting provider 'dropfile.to/api/upload' at IP 185.220.101.42.

Secondary Distribution: Outbound email from david.vance99@protonmail.com to Dr. Jonathan Stern (j.stern@competitor-lab.org) providing download URL 'https://dropfile.to/d/9x8K2L1q' and passcode 'droneAI_v4_secret' in exchange for research fellowship.
Physical Mirroring: USB drive copy attempted to 'E:\Stolen_Dump\project_backup_v2.zip' on SanDisk Ultra (Serial 4C530001290818115243).

attack_chain.title: Unauthorized Access & Lateral Ingress
attack_chain.details: Remote Desktop (RDP) connection established to victim workstation LAB-WS-07 (192.168.1.45:3389) from DEV-LAPTOP-14 (192.168.1.78) using account 'dvance'.

attack_chain.title: Directory Traversal & Confidential File Access
attack_chain.details: User 'dvance' traversed Alex Mercer's confidential folder 'C:\Projects\FinalYear_DroneAI\' and accessed core algorithms, model weights, lidar datasets, and final dissertation.

attack_chain.title: Data Staging & Compression
attack_chain.details: Creation of single staging archive 'C:\Users\Public\project_backup_v2.zip' (142.8 MB) using 7z.exe containing all four critical project files.

attack_chain.title: Physical / Secondary Exfiltration Attempt
attack_chain.details: Insertion of SanDisk Ultra USB 3.0 (Serial: 4C530001290818115243) mounted as E:\, followed by copying staging archive to E:\Stolen_Dump.

attack_chain.title: Network Cloud Exfiltration
attack_chain.details: Chrome launched in incognito mode to dropfile.to. Staging archive uploaded via HTTP POST to 185.220.101.42 (143,120,400 bytes). Received public download link https://dropfile.to/d/9x8K2L1q.

attack_chain.title: External Distribution & Monetization
attack_chain.details: David Vance sent an email from david.vance99@protonmail.com to competitor lab (j.stern@competitor-lab.org) containing the dropfile.to link and encryption password.

attack_chain.title: Anti-Forensics & Log Scrubbing
attack_chain.details: Execution of 'cmd.exe /c del' to permanently delete staging archive from C:\Users\Public\ and termination of RDP session.
